import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d['carrier']=f.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv',''); rows.append(d)
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
# select per-carrier relevant columns and calculate clock-minute difference, correcting midnight crossings
x['s']=x.apply(lambda r: r['sched_dep'] if pd.notna(r.get('sched_dep')) else r['sched_dep_utc'],axis=1)
x['a']=x.apply(lambda r: r['actual_dep'] if pd.notna(r.get('actual_dep')) else r['actual_dep_utc'],axis=1)
def mins(v): return int(v[:2])*60+int(v[3:])
x['delay']=x.apply(lambda r: mins(r.a)-mins(r.s),axis=1)
x.loc[x.delay < -720,'delay'] += 1440
x.loc[x.delay > 720,'delay'] -= 1440
c=x[~x.cancelled]
print(c.groupby('carrier').agg(n=('delay','size'),sum=('delay','sum'),avg=('delay','mean')).to_string())
print('total',len(c),c.delay.sum(),c.delay.mean(), 'rounded',round(c.delay.mean(),1))
print('cross midnight candidates',x[(x.delay>720)|(x.delay< -720)][['flight_id','date','s','a','delay']])

import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); carrier=f.split('/')[-1][:2]
 idcol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; scol='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; acol='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d['carrier']=carrier; d['datecol']=d[idcol]; d['sched']=d[scol]; d['actual']=d[acol]
 rows.append(d[['flight_id','carrier','datecol','sched','actual','cancelled']])
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(x),'unique ids',x.flight_id.nunique(),'duplicates',x.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
print('cancelled/empty inconsistencies',((x.cancelled)&x.actual.notna()).sum(),((~x.cancelled)&x.actual.isna()).sum())
print(x.datecol.value_counts().sort_index().head(),x.datecol.value_counts().sort_index().tail())
# calculate elapsed with date + time, date field scheduled date, actual next day if clock lower
comp=x[~x.cancelled & x.actual.notna()].copy()
base=pd.to_datetime(comp.datecol+' '+comp.sched)
act=pd.to_datetime(comp.datecol+' '+comp.actual)
act=act.where(act>=base,act+pd.Timedelta(days=1))
comp['delay']=(act-base).dt.total_seconds()/60
print(comp.shape, comp.delay.describe(), 'mean',comp.delay.mean(),'sum',comp.delay.sum())
print('negative', (comp.delay<0).sum(), 'max',comp.delay.max())

# using x from prior state
c=x[~x.cancelled & x.actual.notna()].copy()
def mins(s):
 h,m=map(int,s.split(':')); return h*60+m
c['raw']=c.apply(lambda r: mins(r.actual)-mins(r.sched),axis=1)
print(c.raw.describe(percentiles=[.01,.05,.1,.9,.95,.99]))
print('raw neg counts', (c.raw<0).sum(), 'less -600',(c.raw<-600).sum())
print(c.loc[c.raw<-600,['carrier','datecol','sched','actual','raw']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
print('small negatives',c.loc[(c.raw<0)&(c.raw>-600),['carrier','sched','actual','raw']].head(20).to_string(index=False))

du=x[x.flight_id.duplicated(False)].sort_values('flight_id'); print(du.to_string(index=False))
# dedupe IDs first
c=x.drop_duplicates('flight_id').loc[lambda z: (~z.cancelled)&z.actual.notna()].copy()
def mm(s):
 h,m=map(int,s.split(':')); return h*60+m
c['raw']=c.apply(lambda r:mm(r.actual)-mm(r.sched),axis=1)
c['delay']=c.raw.where(c.raw>=-600,c.raw+1440)
print('completed unique',len(c),'sum',c.delay.sum(),'mean',c.delay.mean(),'round',round(c.delay.mean(),1))
print(c.delay.describe(), 'early',(c.delay<0).sum(), 'rollover',(c.raw<-600).sum())

import pandas as pd, glob
allrows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d['carrier']=f.split('/')[-1][:2]
 # normalize
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; sc='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; ac='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d=d.rename(columns={datecol:'date0',sc:'sched0',ac:'actual0'})
 allrows.append(d[['flight_id','date0','sched0','actual0','cancelled','carrier']])
df=pd.concat(allrows,ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(df),'unique',df.flight_id.nunique(),'dups',df.flight_id.duplicated().sum(), 'cancelled vals',df.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print('dates',df.date0.min(),df.date0.max())
# exact duplicated rows?
print('duplicate ids differing',df.groupby('flight_id').nunique().max(numeric_only=True).sort_values(ascending=False).head())
# calculate
x=df.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
x['sched_m']=x.sched0.str[:2].astype(int)*60+x.sched0.str[3:].astype(int)
x['act_m']=x.actual0.where(x.actual0.notna()).str[:2].astype('float')*60+x.actual0.where(x.actual0.notna()).str[3:].astype('float')
x['delay']=x.act_m-x.sched_m
# adjust negative clock difference as overnight +1440, but beware early flights: if negative >? any negative likely early small; actual after midnight gives - large. use if < -720
x.loc[x.delay < -720,'delay'] += 1440
comp=x[x.cancelled==False]
print('completed',len(comp),'cancelled',len(x)-len(comp),'delay missing',comp.delay.isna().sum())
print(comp.delay.describe())
print('mean',comp.delay.mean(), 'sum',comp.delay.sum())

import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); carrier=f.split('/')[-1][:2]; utc='date_utc' in d.columns
 dc='date_utc' if utc else 'date'; sc='sched_dep_utc' if utc else 'sched_dep'; ac='actual_dep_utc' if utc else 'actual_dep'
 d=d.rename(columns={dc:'date0',sc:'sched0',ac:'actual0'}); d['carrier']=carrier; d['utc']=utc
 rows.append(d[['flight_id','date0','origin','sched0','actual0','cancelled','carrier','utc']])
x=pd.concat(rows).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
# local date: AS UTC converted by airport offset
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv')[['airport','utc_offset_hours']]
x=x.merge(ap,left_on='origin',right_on='airport',how='left')
x['dt']=pd.to_datetime(x.date0+' '+x.sched0)
x.loc[x.utc,'dt']=x.loc[x.utc,'dt']+pd.to_timedelta(x.loc[x.utc,'utc_offset_hours'],unit='h')
x['local_date']=x.dt.dt.date
x['sm']=x.sched0.str[:2].astype(int)*60+x.sched0.str[3:].astype(int)
x['am']=x.actual0.str[:2].astype(float)*60+x.actual0.str[3:].astype(float)
x['delay']=x.am-x.sm
x.loc[x.delay < -720,'delay']+=1440
z=x[(x.local_date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(x.local_date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())&(x.cancelled==False)]
print('all included completed',len(z),'sum',z.delay.sum(),'mean',z.delay.mean())
print('AS included',x[(x.carrier=='AS') & (x.local_date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(x.local_date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())].shape)
print('excluded by local date',x[(x.local_date<pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())|(x.local_date>pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())][['flight_id','date0','origin','local_date','delay']].to_dict('records'))
